body:
Release 2.0.0: the Tuppu rebrand. Unreleased on main since 1.17.0: T-212
(category reorder arrows), T-213 (web login mark), T-210 (refused item marker),
T-214 (unknown_list sentence), T-209 (Robolectric flake root-caused to
WorkManager), T-215 (the name), T-216 (the mark).
Major version: a rebrand of the product; the wire contract is unchanged, so
1.x clients keep working. Chosen over 1.0.0, which would sort below every
installed 1.17.0 and be offered to no device by the update check.
title: Release 2.0.0
